metadata.title: Bourgain's Theorem for a Union of Euclidean Metric Spaces
metadata.abstract: We study the distortion of embedding a union of $k$ Euclidean sets into Euclidean space. We show that a union of $k$ Euclidean sets can be embedded with distortion at most $O(k^{1.128} \log k)$, independent of the number of points. This is an exponential improvement over the previous best known upper bound of $2^{O(k)}$ obtained by iterating the result of Makarychev and Makarychev (2016) for the special case $k = 2$. Surprisingly, with the additional assumption that each Euclidean set remains Euclidean when we adjoin any other two points, we can obtain an asymptotically tight distortion of $O(\log k)$, thus, providing a generalization of Bourgain's Theorem (1985). Along the way, we also show that the distortion of the union can be upper bounded by $O(\log k)$ times the maximum of the Lipschitz extension constants of individual Euclidean sets.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 欧氏子空间并的嵌入失真界
analysis.workSummary: 设度量空间X=∪_(i=1)^k U_i，各U_i以诱导度量等距嵌入ℓ₂。定理1.2给c₂(X)=O(k^1.128 log k)，k=2时改进至c₂(X)<3.997。若每个U_i加入X中任意一点仍等距欧氏，则定理1.3给O(k^.895 log k)；加入任意两点仍欧氏时，定理1.1给渐近尖锐的O(log k)。
techniques: Bourgain式抽样组合最近子集映射
Kirszbraun定理与子集到X的Lipschitz延拓常数
二次能量的Euclidean metric sparsifier对偶
加回集合顺序的平均与1+η/r乘积控制
analysis.breakthrough: 定理1.4将e_max=max_i e(U_i)与失真联系为e_max≤c₂(X)≤O(e_max log(k+1))，这里e(U_i)是所有到ℓ₂的Lipschitz映射从U_i延至X的最小统一放大系数。有限集上的延拓界由度量稀疏化推出，再经可分性及紧致性推广。两种构造的指数分别为η₀=1.1275…、η₁=.8941…，给出所述略取整上界。
analysis.limitations: 一般欧氏并及一点扩充情形的多项式上界未证最优，当前失真下界仍是Ω(log k)。延拓常数的Ω(√log k)及Ω((log k)^(1/4))下界不直接给同阶失真最优性。目标为ℓ₂，任意无限空间情形未给统一有限维目标界。依赖所引Kirszbraun、双侧嵌入与紧致性结果，本次仅核对主结果和路线，未逐式复核稀疏化对偶及指数优化。
analysis.aiEvidence: 第28页明确区分作者独立完成的二点强欧氏定理1.1，以及向GPT-6 Astra提供其证明后由模型获得的定理1.2/1.3结果，构成具体主要结果与证明路线的归因，记ideas和proofs。作者显著重写表述，并独立发现Lipschitz延拓和度量稀疏化联系，不能扩大为全部结果均由AI产生。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2611.08546v1 · PDF第28页 Generative AI Statement
